# Agriclé

> > Agriclé is a Quebec-based supplier of agricultural, residential, and industrial equipment specializing in livestock solutions, dairy farming supplies, and farm construction materials.

Agriclé offers a comprehensive range of products including livestock equipment from brands like Suevia, Milk Bar, and Supreme Buddy Hutch, along with HDPE materials, rubber mats, waterers, and calf care solutions for modern farming operations.

## Key Topics

- Livestock Equipment
- Dairy Farming
- Calf Care & Equipment
- HDPE (High Density Polyethylene)
- Animal Watering Systems
- Suevia Products
- Milk Bar Feeding Systems
- Supreme Buddy Hutch
- Calf Buddy
- Rubber Mats
- Farm Construction Materials
- Cattle Products
- Animal Welfare
- Quebec Agricultural Supplies
- Split Saver
